=== FINDING 7 — global-scope plaintext join, documented deviation — VERIFIED ===
(a) Join warning: VERIFIED. bin/fah_dap_scoped.dart `_globalJoin` (:626-671); the warning (:644-649) fires only on the private global path (`invite.pub != null && priv != null`, :635) and its text names everything claimed: "persists the #<id> key as PLAINTEXT in ~/.dap/channels.json — byte-equivalent with `fa dap import` (the legacy store has no envelope field). Pick session/project scope for passphrase-encrypted keys." Printed to the user via `_notifyNetworkJoin` (bin/fah_hub_plugin.dart), which context.io.writeln's every outcome.warning after a join. Keyless/public global join correctly carries no warning. hubClientSecret at global scope is memory-only with its own warning (:659-669). Test 'global-scope plaintext persistence is announced in the join warnings' pins 'PLAINTEXT' + 'fa dap import' and the no-warning public case.
(b) Docs rows: VERIFIED — docs/dap.md §15.2 table global row (legacy ~/.dap files) + §15.3 paragraph (~:737-740): "Global scope is the deliberate exception… persists the invite keypair PLAINTEXT, byte-equivalent with `fa dap import`… the legacy ~/.dap/channels.json format has no envelope field." Accurate vs code.
(c) Session/project route through encryptChannelPriv: VERIFIED. `join` (:603-624) routes non-global scopes to `_scopedJoin` → `_scopedSecretsForStorage` (:699-730): priv stored as `await encryptChannelPriv(priv, passphrase)` (:725), hubClientSecret likewise (:726-728); no passphrase anywhere → `_keepScopedSecretsInMemory` (:732-757): loud warning + in-memory only, nothing plaintext on disk. `_persistScopedJoin` (:759-768): session → `dap_channel_membership` session record; project → `_projectJoin` (:770-779) → `.fah/dap.json`. Test AC8/AC14 asserts session record priv `isEncryptedChannelPriv` and project file contains 'dapkey1.' but not the plaintext key.
(d) Residual silent paths: none found. The composer-paste wizard routes through the SAME `_networkJoin` path (docs/dap.md §15.1: paste intercept opens the join wizard prefilled; default scope session; warnings printed for any scope chosen). Env provisioning (DAP_CHANNELS_JSON / DAP_CLIENT_SECRET) never writes a store — test AC10 asserts no store files are created. `fa dap import` itself persists plaintext (fah_dap_command.dart `runDapImport` → client.persistChannelKeys) — pre-existing, documented, and the byte-equivalence REG target.

=== FINDING 8 — _loadProject drops all memberships on one malformed entry — PARTIAL ===
(a) Per-entry decode: VERIFIED. `_loadProject` bin/fah_dap_scoped.dart:285-315 (claim said 291-318 — close): per-entry loop :302-313, each entry wrapped in its own try; `entry is! Map` throws FormatException; decode failure → `loadWarnings.add('dap: skipped a malformed project membership')` (:311) and the entry is skipped; survivors load. Mirrors `_loadSession` (:319+). The membership-dropping defect itself IS fixed.
(b) "Loud" via loadWarnings surfaced to the user: NOT DELIVERED. `loadWarnings` is a public field on DapScopedMemberships, but no production code ever reads it. Full-file reads of the only production consumer (bin/fah_hub_plugin.dart, all 1980 lines) plus bin/fah_runapp.dart, fah_util.dart, fah_model.dart show ZERO references to loadWarnings outside the service and tests. lib/ cannot reach it (bin-only class). Consequence: a malformed project entry (and likewise boot-time decrypt failures, e.g. wrong-passphrase AC15 warnings) is recorded in memory but NEVER printed — from the user's perspective the skip is silent. Only join/leave-time `DapScopedOutcome.warnings` are printed (_notifyNetworkJoin).
(c) Outer try: now only wraps `jsonDecode(await File(file).readAsString())` (:288-293) and still returns `const []` SILENTLY for a wholly unreadable/unparseable file — no loadWarning there either (test 'a wholly unreadable project file still degrades to empty (no throw), like before' pins this). So one bad entry no longer unjoins everything (fixed), but the loud-warning half of the claim is not wired.
(d) Test: EXISTS — 'one malformed project entry warns and keeps the rest' (group 'project store resilience', ~:407-436): writes [valid, 'garbage', stale-missing-scope], asserts effective == ['good'] and loadWarnings contains 'malformed project membership'. NOT RUN (no exec tool). Note the test asserts against the in-memory field, so it cannot catch the surfacing gap.

=== .gitignore / AC14 — VERIFIED ===
- `.gitignore` now whitelists `!.fah/dap.json` (immediately after `.fah/*` and the curated `!.fah/...` list), with an explicit comment: "`.fah/dap.json` joins the whitelist per gh-1825 v3: the DAP channel store MAY be committed because it holds ENCRYPTED (`dapkey1.`) keys only — never plaintext (AC14)."
- Project-scope write path cannot introduce plaintext: `_projectJoin` (:770-779) rewrites `.fah/dap.json` from loaded memberships plus the new `stored` membership whose priv is `encryptChannelPriv` output (`dapkey1.…`) or absent — every stored priv is dapkey1.-prefixed or envelope-wrapped. Residual: a PRE-EXISTING plaintext priv already in .fah/dap.json (hand-edit/older build) round-trips verbatim through _loadProject→toJson() rewrites — never re-encrypted by this PR, so the committed-file invariant depends on the initial content.

=== CLAIM-LINE DELTAS (for the record) ===
_loadProject actual :285-315 (claim 291-318) • prune fn is `sweepLegacyOverlays` :512, not `_pruneStaleOverlay` (keep-on-doubt :546 matches claim) • cleanupOverlay :497-504 (claim 493-500) • docs overlay row ~:732 / deviation ~:737-740 (match) • both claimed tests exist at ~the claimed lines.

BOTTOM LINE: F7 and the .gitignore/AC14 checks are solid. F6 and F8 share one root gap: the new unit machinery is correct and tested, but the host never wires it — cleanupOverlay is never invoked on any shutdown path (no plugin dispose exists), and loadWarnings is never printed. Both need a host-side hook (e.g. a plugin teardown seam invoked from the CLI finally blocks / exitInteractive130/_gracefulHeadlessExit, printing scoped.loadWarnings after boot seed and before exit).
